name: Cycle plan
oneLine: 4 coins bought monthly until 1 June 2028, held, then sold in thirds from 1 June 2029 to 31 October 2029. The plan rests on a forecast that may not come true.
riskLabel: Very high risk · time-bound bet on a cycle
explanation:
This template encodes a forecast about 2029 that may not come true: that Bitcoin’s highs keep coming about 4 years apart, the next between 1 September 2029 and 31 October 2029. It splits each monthly amount 40 % Bitcoin, 30 % Ethereum, 15 % Solana, and 15 % Chainlink. The plan’s last buy is on 1 June 2028, after the halving it places on 15 April 2028. The plan marks thirds to sell from 1 June 2029, 1 August 2029, and 1 October 2029, whatever the price. Nothing is held after 31 December 2029.

People pick it to decide the selling in advance rather than on a day the market moves. What can go wrong: past cycles are too few data points to be a law. The high can come before the window, after it, or not at all. Solana fell 97 % from its high on 6 November 2021 to its low on 29 December 2022. Chainlink fell 91 % from its high on 10 May 2021 to its low on 10 June 2023.

From 1 June 2028 its dates no longer fill in, and the app asks for new ones.
